evidence: Walked all 52 criteria (2 gates, 40 functional, 5 polish, 5 visual). Nearly all state one bar: alternatives such as 'hiding it is optional', 'whether tried through the UI or, if not offered, by replay', 'graded only in <row>' and alternative evidence forms (hro_stale_refused, hro_reject_reason, hro_candidate_private) are equivalent ways to meet one bar or ownership notes, not waivers (lesson 16 / skill false positive on flow bundling). Two instances leave the judge two targets: (1) tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:139 hro_refused_put_back (weight 2) lists three requirements, 'the card is shown in its real stage and place, the reason is shown, and keyboard focus is on a control of that card', then adds alternatives: 'A UI that refuses before the card moves, with the reason shown and focus on that card, also passes, as does a UI that does not offer the move at all while that card shows why (Interview is full).' The third alternative leaves out focus (and the put-back), yet the same text then says 'Fails if ... focus is not on a control of that card. Fails if any condition stated above does not hold.' Protocol L (functional/prompt.md:39) also expects 'focus is on that card's controls', and the general protocol (prompt.md:31) sends a not-offered move to a replay, so on the 'not offered' path no page ever 'tried the full-Interview move' and nothing places focus. For a UI that does not offer the move, one reading passes the row on the alternative and the other fails it on the focus clause. The brief (hireops_rules.md:85-88) asks for focus on the card's controls after a refused move. (2) functional/judge.toml:40 hro_add_candidate: 'with the entered name (and the email wherever the app shows card details)' ... 'Fails if the card is missing, misplaced, shows wrong details or is not shared. The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details.' The Fails list penalizes only WRONG details, which supports 'if shown, must match' (the same reading as hro_job_open line 31, 'any ... value the app shows for it matches'). The trailing source sentence, caught by the catch-all, reads as 'source must be displayed in any details view.' A details panel showing name and email but not source passes one reading and fails the other. Lower-risk observations, not defects: polish/judge.toml:25 hro_pol_live_board has a narrow, explicit fallback that drops the scroll leg ('only if neither can be made to scroll with twelve cards ... record that and judge the other legs'); it is one bar. polish/judge.toml:61 hro_pol_session_resume says '(that also passes)' about the self-prompted sign-in leg; in context it is leg-scoped, but it could be misread as whole-row credit. The gates and the visual likert anchors are self-consistent. Lessons-file check: no row restates and then waives a 'scored elsewhere' leg inconsistently. Ownership notes (hro_job_open -> hro_interview_full and the manager rows, hro_drafts -> hro_msg_compose, hro_candidate_view -> hro_candidate_private, hro_activity_refusals) match their owning rows.
counterexample: (1) An app disables E's 'Move to Interview' control with a visible 'Interview is full (2/2)' note on E's card. When the judge selects E, focus stays on the board or the body. A judge reading the third alternative passes hro_refused_put_back (weight 2). A judge applying 'Fails if ... focus is not on a control of that card' / protocol L's focus leg fails it. The same app gets different scores depending on which reading the judge takes. (2) An app with a card-details drawer showing name and email but not source: hro_add_candidate passes under the Fails list ('shows wrong details') and fails under the trailing 'The entered source is shown wherever the app shows card details'.
suggested_fix: hro_refused_put_back: either drop the 'does not offer the move at all' alternative, or state its full bar explicitly (e.g. 'that card shows why Interview is full and keyboard focus is on that card's controls after the attempt') and make the Fails list and protocol L name the same legs. hro_add_candidate: choose one bar: either 'any email or source the app shows for the card matches what was entered' (put this in the Fails list) or 'the card details view shows the entered email and source' (and add a public sentence asking for it). Optionally reword hro_pol_session_resume '(that also passes)' to '(that leg also passes)'.
